notes: Plant wind case P07_grass_meadow (Grass meadow) written by scripts/build_plants.py: Ten 15279 grass stems on a base plate. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: blade_1: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-70.0, 0.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_2: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-50.0, 0.0, 10.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_3: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-30.0, 0.0, -10.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_4: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-30.0, 0.0, 30.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_5: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-10.0, 0.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_6: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [10.0, 0.0, 10.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_7: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [30.0, 0.0, -10.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_8: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [30.0, 0.0, 30.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_9: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [50.0, 0.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud); blade_10: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [70.0, 0.0, 10.0] (flex_approx: the grass stem is one rigid part; the tilt stands in for the blade bending. 15279 on a base stud).

Real LEGO freedoms: none. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): blade_1, blade_2, blade_3, blade_4, blade_5, blade_6, blade_7, blade_8, blade_9, blade_10.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): blade_1 + = Blade 1 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_2 + = Blade 2 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_3 + = Blade 3 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_4 + = Blade 4 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_5 + = Blade 5 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_6 + = Blade 6 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_7 + = Blade 7 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_8 + = Blade 8 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_9 + = Blade 9 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); blade_10 + = Blade 10 at its stud (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X).

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
